description.en: Returns the handle of the map model loaded for the skill scenes (the background map of CMND_RUN_SKILL_SCRIPT), if one is loaded. RunSkillScript shows it again after the scene.

The skill map handle.
When no skill map is loaded, nothing is pushed: the native returns a value read from the script system instead of a count, so the script normally gets null. null too if the script system is not ready.
